name: Erase Memories
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level Hellenic sorceress 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (mixture of herbs worth 10 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cloud the target’s mind, temporarily blocking access to most of his memories. He remembers his name and all of his personal abilities (skills, feats, class abilities, languages, and so on) but not his personal history (including friends, family, or enemies), homeland, or goals.

The mixture of herbs used as the material component for this spell must be fed to the target within one hour of casting this spell for the spell to last longer than 1 hour.
